security.saveHint: Passwords apply when you save. They are kept in memory only and never written to disk.
security.encryptedNote: This file is protected by a password.
security.signedBlocked: The file is digitally signed: setting or removing a password would break the signatures.

inspect.title: Inspect file & remove hidden data
inspect.description: See what the file holds beyond its visible pages: metadata, JavaScript, attachments, hidden layers, comments... Tick what to clean and remove it.
inspect.signedBlocked: The file is digitally signed: removing data would break the signatures.
inspect.hiddenTextNote: Hidden text (white or invisible text, text outside the page) is only reported. Removing it needs rewriting the page content, so it cannot be removed automatically.

cat.launchActions: Actions that open a program or file
cat.revisionHistory: Revision history (old versions in the file)

hint.metadata: Can be removed: author, last editor and the producing software may reveal internal details.
hint.embeddedFiles: Files embedded inside the PDF. All can be removed.
hint.javascript: Scripts can run when the file opens. Better removed.
hint.launchActions: Actions that open another app or file. Better removed.
hint.hiddenLayers: Layers can be switched on to reveal hidden content.
hint.comments: Notes, annotations and markup by readers.
hint.thumbnails: Thumbnails can still hold older page content.
hint.externalLinks: Links to web pages or other files.
hint.xfa: Old XFA data, which may contain scripts.
hint.revisionHistory: Older versions stored in the file may contain deleted content.
hint.unusedObjects: Objects no longer referenced. Removing them makes the file smaller.

noFix.hiddenText: Report only. Cannot be removed automatically.
noFix.fontsNotEmbedded: Report only. Missing fonts may display differently on other machines.

preflight.title: Check before sending
preflight.description: Run one check: leftover metadata, comments, unflattened forms, file size, signatures. Press Fix to handle each item.
preflight.manual: No automatic fix. See the related tool.
preflight.signedBlocked: The file is digitally signed: fixing it would break the signatures.

colour.title: Convert colours
colour.description: Change the colours of "{{name}}": greyscale, black and white, ink saver, or replace one colour with another.
colour.signedBlocked: Digitally signed document: colours cannot be changed without breaking the signature.

issue.pages: The page range is invalid or empty.
issue.threshold: The threshold must be a whole number from 0 to 255.
issue.amount: The amount must be from 0 to 100%.
issue.sourceColor: The source colour must look like #rrggbb.
issue.targetColor: The target colour must look like #rrggbb.
issue.tolerance: The tolerance must be a whole number from 0 to 255.

modeHint.gray: Turns every colour into grey. Text and lines stay as they are.
modeHint.blackwhite: Only black and white remain. The threshold decides which points turn black.
modeHint.ink-saver: Lightens every colour by the chosen amount to use less ink when printing.
modeHint.replace-color: Replaces the points close to the source colour with the target colour.

colour.thresholdHint: Points lighter than the threshold become white, darker ones black (0–255).
colour.ditheringHint: Black and white images look smoother, but the file may be larger.
colour.toleranceHint: Each of the R, G and B channels may differ by up to this value (0–255).

pageTools.signedBlocked: Digitally signed document: pages cannot be changed without breaking the signature. Work on an unsigned copy.

issue.pages: The page range is invalid or empty.
issue.target: Enter the pages to replace, inside the document.
issue.sourcePages: The page range of the source file is invalid.
issue.margins: Margins must be numbers from 0 to 500 mm.
issue.box: The box needs x1 greater than x0 and y1 greater than y0.
issue.padding: The padding must be from 0 to 50 mm.
issue.rows: The number of rows must be from 1 to 10.
issue.cols: The number of columns must be from 1 to 10.
issue.overlap: The overlap must be from 0 to 50 mm.
issue.customSize: The width and height must be greater than 0.
issue.level: The outline level must be from 1 to 10.
issue.pattern: A valid regular expression is needed.
issue.outputDir: Choose a folder for the files.
issue.nameTemplate: The name template cannot be empty and may only use {name}, {index}, {start}, {end}.

replace.title: Replace pages
replace.description: Replace pages of "{{name}}" with pages taken from another PDF file.
replace.sourcePages: Pages taken from the source file
replace.sourcePagesHint: Leave empty to take all pages. Click a page image to pick it.

crop.title: Crop margins / resize
crop.description: Change the page box of "{{name}}". Nothing is deleted; only the visible area changes.

split.title: Split pages
split.description: Split each page of "{{name}}" into a grid of rows × columns, for example an A3 page into two A4 pages.

smart.title: Smart split
smart.description: Split one PDF into several files at blank separator pages, at an outline level, or at headings that match a pattern.
smart.dropSeparatorsHint: Blank separator pages are not written to the result files.
smart.sensitivityHint: Higher values treat pages with a few specks as blank.

blank.title: Remove blank pages
blank.description: Find blank pages in "{{name}}" and choose which ones to delete. Review them before deleting.
blank.keepAnnotationsHint: Pages with notes or signature fields are never treated as blank.
blank.explain: Pages flagged as blank are checked by default. Uncheck any page you want to keep.

dewarp.title: Flatten curved page
dewarp.description: Preview the corrected text lines before applying gentle page-curl correction.
dewarp.pagesHint: Leave empty to select all. Preview shows up to the first 3 pages in the range.
dewarp.previewEmpty: Choose pages and preview before applying.
dewarp.previewCount: Previewing the first {{count}} pages in the selected range.
dewarp.reviewWarning: {{pages}} need review because there are not enough clear text lines; those pages will be left unchanged.
dewarp.skippedWarning: {{pages}} do not have a suitable page image to preview.
dewarp.applyReview: Pages {{pages}} did not meet the confidence threshold and were left unchanged.

spine.title: Adjust spine
spine.description: See the automatic spine position on a two-page spread. You can move it by hand and split at that position.
spine.pagesHint: Leave empty to select all pages. Previews show at most the first 3 pages in the range.
spine.position: Spine position: {{value}}% of the width (applied to every selected page)
spine.previewEmpty: Choose pages and press Preview to see the spine.
spine.skippedWarning: Skipped pages {{pages}}: the page image could not be read.
spine.lowConfidence: Pages {{pages}} have a weak spine. Adjust by hand.
spine.applyReview: Pages {{pages}} need review: the spine is unclear, not split.

finger.title: Remove fingers
finger.description: Propose the finger regions on the page edges, then adjust them with the brush. Red areas are filled with paper colour.
finger.pageHint: One page at a time. Propose first, then adjust.
finger.previewEmpty: Enter a page number and press Propose to see the finger regions.
finger.noProposal: No fingers found on this page.
finger.coverage: Area to remove: {{value}}% of the page

erase.title: Erase areas and colour stains
erase.description: Drag boxes to erase areas on the page (filled with paper or white), or remove one ink colour (blue pen, highlighter, red stamp).
erase.pageHint: One page at a time. Preview the page, then drag boxes.
erase.previewEmpty: Enter a page number and press Preview to draw boxes.
erase.noPicture: The page image could not be read.
erase.stainHint: Choose one ink. Only pixels of that ink are removed; black text and the paper stay.
erase.stainPagesHint: Leave empty to select all pages.

adjust.title: Adjust page image
adjust.description: Whiten the background, reduce noise, set levels and curve, contrast, invert, grey, or change DPI. Compare before and after on one page.
adjust.pagesHint: Leave empty to adjust all pages.
adjust.previewEmpty: Choose a page and press Preview to compare.
adjust.noPicture: The page image could not be read.
adjust.levelsInvalid: The white point must be above the black point.
adjust.dpiHint: Leave empty to keep the current DPI. From 50 to 1200.
adjust.resizePage: Keep pixels, change the page size to the DPI

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.description: Reduce the size of "{{name}}": lower image resolution, drop unused objects, subset fonts. The estimate is exact but slow, because it really compresses the file.

presetIssue.tooLong: The name can have up to {{max}} characters.

compress.invalidDpi: The resolution must be from 36 to 1200 dpi.
compress.invalidQuality: The JPEG quality must be from 1 to 100.

opt.grayscaleHint: Greatly reduces the size of colour images.
opt.removeUnusedHint: Drops images and forms that no page uses.
opt.removeAttachmentsHint: The files embedded in the PDF are lost.
opt.subsetFonts: Subset fonts (keep only the characters used)
opt.flattenHint: Needed for some images with alpha masks.

compress.fitHint: Finds the first compression level that reaches this size, then fills in the matching options.

fit.done: Under {{mb}} MB: about {{size}} MB. The options are filled in.
fit.unreachable: {{mb}} MB could not be reached; the smallest is about {{size}} MB. That level is filled in.

compress.signedBlocked: The file is digitally signed: compressing it would break the signatures.

result.images: Images compressed: {{processed}} · Images kept as they are: {{skipped}}

reason.jpeg2000: {{count}} JPEG 2000 images kept as they are
reason.bilevel: {{count}} black-and-white images kept as they are
reason.unusual: {{count}} images with unusual colour spaces kept as they are

capture.short: Scan a QR code and take pages with a phone
capture.title: Capture with a phone
capture.description: The phone takes each page and sends it to this computer. Nothing to install on the phone.
capture.intro: Press Start to show a QR code. Scan it with the phone camera, then take each page.
capture.sameWifi: The phone and this computer must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
capture.firewall: If the phone cannot open the page, allow Chef PDF in the Windows firewall (Windows Defender) when Windows asks, then try again.
capture.options: Processing after the PDF is made
capture.optCropHint: Cut away the border around each page and straighten skewed pages.
capture.optSplitHint: For photos that show two book pages at once.
capture.reviewPages: Pages {{pages}} need a check: their edges were not clear.
capture.errNoLan: No local network found. Connect this computer to Wi-Fi or a network cable, then try again.
capture.errNoInterface: The chosen network address was not found.
capture.errExpired: The capture session expired (after 10 minutes). Start again to get a new QR code.
capture.errGeneric: The capture session could not start. Try again later.

web2pdf.title: Web page / Markdown → PDF
web2pdf.description: Convert a web page (http/https), a Markdown or an HTML file to PDF.
web2pdf.kindFile: Markdown or HTML file on this computer
web2pdf.urlHint: http and https only. The page is downloaded to print it.
web2pdf.confirm: I confirm loading this web page
web2pdf.needSource: Enter a web page address or choose a file.
web2pdf.needConfirm: Confirm before loading the web page.
web2pdf.needOutput: Choose where to save the PDF file.
web2pdf.mdNote: Markdown is handled safely: no scripts run, and only images in the same folder are shown.

convert.title: Convert
convert.pdfDescription: Export the pages of "{{name}}" as image files.
convert.nameTemplateHint: {name} is the PDF name, {page} is the page number.
convert.imagesDescription: Combine several PNG or JPG images into one PDF. Use the arrows to change the order.
convert.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard has no PNG image.
convert.noImages: No images yet. Add images or paste a screenshot from the clipboard.

stamp.title: Stamp
stamp.description: Stamp text or a picture onto the selected pages. You can remove it in the overlay manager.

text.label: Text
text.hint: New line splits the text. Insert {date}, {time} or {user} to fill them when stamping.

stamp.multiplyHint: The ink darkens what is under it instead of covering it.

seam.title: Cross-page seal
seam.description: One seal cut into equal strips across the edges of the pages: each page takes one strip and together they form the whole seal. You can remove it in the overlay manager.
seam.multiplyHint: The ink darkens what is underneath instead of covering the text.
seam.cutFirstPage: The first page of each set also gets a strip

err.groupSize: Pages per set must be a whole number from 0 to 10000.
err.overlapMm: Overlap must be from 0 to 50 mm.
err.scaleWidthMm: Width must be from 0 to 1000 mm.
err.verticalMm: Distance from the top must be from 0 to 10000 mm.
err.cutFirstPage: No page takes a strip. Choose more pages or turn on the strip on the first page.

initials.title: Initials
initials.description: Place initials or a short signature in a corner, on an edge or in the middle of the chosen pages. You can remove it in the overlay manager.
initials.multiplyHint: The ink darkens what is underneath instead of covering the text.

err.fontSize: Font size must be from 4 to 120.
err.widthMm: Width must be from 1 to 500 mm.
err.marginMm: Margin must be from 0 to 100 mm.

signStamp.title: Stamp before signing
signStamp.note: Stamp first, sign after: the stamps are placed in the document before the signature, so the signature covers them.

outlineEdit.empty: No items yet. Add an item, or build one from the pages.
outlineEdit.noSelection: Select an item to rename it, move it to another page or style it.
outlineEdit.signed: The document is signed, so the outline cannot be changed.
outlineEdit.confirmReplace: Building the outline from the pages replaces the current outline. Continue?
outlineEdit.confirmClear: Clear the whole outline? You can take it back with Undo.
outlineEdit.confirmDiscard: There are unsaved changes. Discard them?

recovery.title: Restore documents
recovery.description: The app closed unexpectedly while these documents were being edited. Do you want to restore the edits?

wm.title: Remove watermark
wm.description: Look for watermarks in "{{name}}". The list is only for review; nothing is removed until you press Remove.
wm.emptyHint: If a watermark is still there, select it with object select mode, then use "Remove objects like this".
wm.notice: Only remove watermarks from documents you are entitled to edit (your own or your company's).

background.title: Remove or replace page background
background.description: Large backgrounds (colour or image covering most of the page) in "{{name}}".
background.notice: Cannot be undone after saving. Only use it on documents you are entitled to edit.

similar.title: Remove objects like this
similar.description: Pick one object on a page (logo, faint image…), then find and remove the objects that look like it.
similar.pick: Pick an object on the page…
similar.none: No object at the point you clicked.

scope.label: Scope
scope.all: All similar objects, including the picked one

redact.title: Redact sensitive information
redact.description: Find and redact sensitive information in "{{name}}".
redact.warning: WARNING: Redaction PERMANENTLY removes the content underneath. It cannot be recovered after saving. Undo works only before saving.
redact.allOccurrences: Select every occurrence of the same text. If one is left out, the check after redaction will report the text is still there.
redact.unchecked: {{count}} unchecked places will stay as they are.

areas.title: Manual redaction areas
areas.draw: Draw an area on the page…
areas.hint: Drag the area to redact on the page. The dialog closes while you draw.

redact.removeFromAnnotations: Remove annotations and form values inside the areas
redact.confirmBody: The redacted content will be removed from the file and cannot be recovered after saving.
redact.leakHint: Select every occurrence of this text and redact again.

objects.title: Objects
objects.hint: Click to select · Shift adds/removes · Ctrl selects a range · Alt picks the object below · Drag to move
objects.selectedHint: {{count}} selected · Delete removes · Ctrl+D duplicates · Arrows nudge 1 pt (Shift: 10 pt)
objects.rotatedHint: Set the page rotation to 0° to edit objects

err.OVERLAPPING_OBJECTS: The objects overlap, so they cannot be edited together.
err.CLIPPED_OBJECT_REORDER: The object is clipped by the view, so its order cannot change.
err.TEXT_TRANSFORM_UNSUPPORTED: This text cannot be transformed (for example rotated or scaled).
err.STALE_OBJECT_IDS: The page has changed. Select the objects again.
err.FORM_CHILD_NEEDS_FLATTEN: The object is inside a form. Flatten the form before editing.
err.INLINE_IMAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Inline images cannot be edited yet.
err.NOT_AN_IMAGE: This object is not an image.
err.IMAGE_NOT_FOUND: The image data was not found.
err.CROP_OUTSIDE_IMAGE: The crop area lies outside the image.
err.INVALID_OBJECT_ID: The object id is not valid.
err.INVALID_ROTATION: The rotation must be 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
err.FILE_NOT_FOUND: The image file was not found.
err.UNREADABLE_IMAGE: The image file cannot be read.

panel.title: Selected objects
panel.none: Select an object on the page to view and edit it.

erase.title: Erase area
erase.hint: Drag a rectangle on the page to choose the area to erase
erase.hintBar: Choose a mode and press Apply. Esc drops the area
erase.rotatedHint: Set the page rotation to 0° to erase
erase.nothing: This area has no content to erase
erase.result: Removed {{removed}} objects, split {{split}}, changed {{images}} images, clipped {{clipped}}

mode.label: Erase mode
mode.cutHint: Really removes the content, leaves no black box
mode.coverHint: Paints the area with one colour

erase.wholeOnly: Only objects lying entirely inside the area
erase.wholeOnlyHint: Objects that only partly overlap the area are kept

layers.label: Layer list
layers.noneText: This document has no content layers (optional content).
layers.removeMessage: Remove layer “{{name}}”. Keep its content (as ordinary content) or delete the content in the layer?
layers.flattenMessage: All content becomes visible and the layer structure is removed. You can undo with Ctrl+Z.

textEdit.title: Edit text
textEdit.hint: Press Enter or double-click to edit this paragraph.
textEdit.hintLine: Press Enter or double-click to edit this line.
textEdit.noGlyphs: Some characters of this line are not in the original font.

warn.overflow: The line is {{pt}} pt longer than the original.
warn.overlap: The paragraph overlaps {{count}} other text blocks (highlighted).

err.TEXT_GLYPH_MISSING: The original font does not have all the characters needed.
err.TEXT_NOT_EDITABLE: This line cannot be edited (text in a watermark or in an image).
err.TEXT_TRANSFORM_UNSUPPORTED: This line is rotated or distorted, so it cannot be edited.
err.TEXT_KEEP_UNSUPPORTED: The original font cannot be kept for this line. Pick the automatic font choice.
err.PARAGRAPH_SHARES_RUN: This paragraph shares a text block with another, so it cannot be edited alone.
err.PARAGRAPH_NOT_FOUND: Paragraph not found. Read the page again.
err.PARAGRAPH_NOT_ON_PAGE: The paragraph is not on this page.
err.LINE_NOT_FOUND: Line not found. The page changed, reading the text again.

err.STALE_OBJECT_IDS: The page changed, reading the text again.
err.UNKNOWN_FONT: This font is not in the list.

findReplace.title: Find & replace
findReplace.desc: Replace a text across the whole document or on the chosen pages.

scope.hint: Every match in the scope is replaced. Single matches cannot be skipped.

findReplace.jump: Click to go to this match

skip.ARTIFACT: watermark or page number text, not edited

links.title: Links
links.desc: Links in the document: to another page, or to a web address or e-mail.
links.formDesc: Choose where the link goes and how it looks.
links.drawHint: Drag on the page to draw the link area. Esc to cancel.
links.detected: Added {{count}} links for web and e-mail addresses in the text.

err.URI_REQUIRED: Enter a web or e-mail address.

annots.title: Notes
annots.selectFirst: Select text on the page first (drag the mouse to select).

tool.note: Sticky note: click on the page
tool.freetext: Text box: drag an area on the page
tool.ink: Draw: drag the mouse to draw
tool.shape: Shape: drag the mouse on the page

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.text: Use the tools in the Notes tab to add some.

flatten.title: Flatten notes?
flatten.body: The notes will be written into the page as fixed content and can no longer be edited. Text and images do not change. Save a copy first if you need the notes.
